title: Women pianists: Mary Lou Williams, Connie Berry, Nellie Lutcher, Rose Murphy
summary: Humes names Mary Lou Williams as the greatest and lists Connie Berry, Nellie Lutcher and Rose Murphy as favourite pianists. Rose Murphy and Major Holley went to Ronnie Scott's after Humes.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Well, we don't have to talk much about it. Well listen, I'll tell you want I want to talk to you about, one or two of those girls. What about Mary Lou (Williams).
Well I think she's the greatest.
On the piano I like Mary Lou and Connie Berry and Nellie Lutcher and Rose Murphy.
Oh, yeah. Is she working around here still?
Yeah, she's still working. She went to Europe and Major Holly went with her.
They went over to Ronnie Scott's right after I left.
